question: In equilateral \(\triangle ABC\), \(AD\) is the median to side \(BC\), and \(BD=4\). Find the perimeter of \(\triangle ABC\).
solution: \(D\) is the midpoint of \(BC\), so \(BC=2BD=8\). The perimeter is \(3\times8=24\).
